description: adm_Drop zones pour vélos et trottinettes partagées gérées par la Ville de Bruxelles (polygones) is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stad Brussel. Drop zones for bicycles and scooters shared managed by the City of Brussels Dropzones are perimeters where it is Permit to park the vehicles of the fleet cyclosharing services free; i.e. bikes, scooters and scooters shared in a free fleet. Coverage: Stad Brussel. The portal shows the English title as "adm_Drop zones for shared bicycles and scooters managed by the City of Brussels (polygons)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stad Brussel. Its keywords include Mobilité. The listing shows 2025-12-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
